name: 3D Printing Wiki
description: An FDM printing reference for materials, slicers, CAD and printer makers. Diagnose defects from illustrated examples, search the glossary and practice with a randomized 30-question quiz.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: The overview links new makers to the first-print guide, defect gallery and practical slicer settings.
The walls and motion filter shows illustrated examples of layer shift, ringing, Z banding and seam defects.
The layer-height article compares layer counts and estimated print times for the same PLA block at four heights.
The filament-drying guide compares the manufacturer’s temperature and time for eight named products.
Searching for stringing brings up the defect alongside related material, drying and travel-move articles.
A practice question asks the reader to pick the photo that shows stringing, then explains the answer.
